changelog: The turn opens with your spell (casting one rules out March), and the first turn opens with a draw. A Look button reads the board at any step; board numbers show in their side's colour and tolls cover a creature's whole field. The end of a battle says what decided it, shows the cards won with New tags and graphs Authority and coverage round by round. Battles are saved every round. Fixes a stuck turn, the pan/zoom swap and the hold that pressed Close.
